scripts.check:selection: tsc src/utils/file-selection.check.ts --outDir .tmp-check --module commonjs --target ES2020 --jsx react --skipLibCheck --esModuleInterop && node .tmp-check/utils/file-selection.check.js
scripts.check:media: rm -rf .tmp-check/media && tsc src/utils/media-preview.check.ts --rootDir src --outDir .tmp-check/media --module commonjs --target ES2020 --jsx react --skipLibCheck --esModuleInterop && node .tmp-check/media/utils/media-preview.check.js
scripts.check:folder: rm -rf .tmp-check/folder && tsc src/utils/folder-upload.check.ts --rootDir src --outDir .tmp-check/folder --module commonjs --target ES2020 --jsx react --skipLibCheck --esModuleInterop && node .tmp-check/folder/utils/folder-upload.check.js
scripts.test: pnpm check:selection && pnpm check:media && pnpm check:folder
